plans.headline: Walk the trails and swing at the playground

main.why: Your toddler can explore the nature areas, wander the greenway and burn off energy on the playground. Home by lunch and well before nap.
tips: Pack a snack to eat at the picnic shelter before the drive home.
Let your child choose which way to walk first.
Give a ten-minute warning before the car so leaving goes smoothly.
